leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a Node.js HTTP server endpoint that handles CSV export requests
Configure response headers to specify CSV content type and enable streaming
Initialize a writable stream to pipe data directly to the HTTP response
Manipulate data structures to format rows into CSV-compatible strings
Integrate a data source with the streaming pipeline to generate CSV content
Control the streaming flow to handle backpressure and memory efficiently
Implement error handling for both stream creation and data processing stages
lessonTitle: Build CSV export endpoint with streaming
